title: cborder
description: A simple datapack that adds a circular border
body:
### A simple datapack that adds a circular border
## Description:
### This pack has 3 rings:
1. Warning: Inside this ring players will be given a warning message
2. Debuff: Inside this ring players will suffer from potion effects
3. Damage: Inside this ring players will take 1 damage per check

Rings 1 and 2 overlap, as do rings 2 and 3.
## Configuration:
### To change values or messages, unpack the datapack and change them isnide the code. (Sorry I have no clue on how to make config for datapacks)
Default values:
- Border at 2048 blocks (128 chunks) from center (0, 0)
- Debuff area 16 blocks earlier, warning area 32 blocks earlier
- Debuff area adds weakness, slowness and blindness
- Checks every 10 ticks
- Damage applied is minecraft:magic (Bypasses armor)
